questions.question: List the vector (genus-level or common name) associated with the following infection:
questions.model_answer: Dengue virus: Aedes mosquito (Aedes aegypti). Malaria: Anopheles mosquito. American trypanosomiasis (Chagas disease): triatomine ("kissing") bug. Endemic (murine) typhus: rat flea (Xenopsylla cheopis).

questions.question: Name the vector, either genus or common name for the following diseases:
questions.model_answer: Dengue: Aedes mosquito. Plasmodium falciparum: Anopheles mosquito. Trypanosoma cruzi: triatomine ("kissing") bug. Endemic (murine) typhus: rat flea (Xenopsylla cheopis).

questions.question: Name the vector of the disease (genus or common name).

cohort_answer.text: Dengue virus - Aedes aegypti or Aedes albopictus. Falciparum malaria - female Anopheles spp. Trypanosoma cruzi - Triatomine insect ('kissing' bug). Endemic Murine Typhus - Xenopsylla cheopis (Rat flea)

questions.question: Trivia: Seven tropical infections that can be diagnosed with peripheral blood smear (Giemsa)

cohort_answer.text: African/American trypanosomiasis, Babesia, Bartonella (bacilliformis - Oroya fever), Filariasis, Malaria, TBRF (tick-borne relapsing fever), LBRF (louse-borne relapsing fever) (also Histoplasmosis, Leptospirosis mentioned)
